title: Free AI Tools Mega Guide
subtitle: A plain-English directory of 150+ AI tools you can try without paying
author: ASDALE DYNAMICS, LLC
description: A plain-English directory of genuinely free and free-tier AI tools for learning, making, writing, building, and getting things done.
disclaimer: Free tiers change. Every allowance, quota, model name, and feature in this guide is a snapshot from the last verified date. Providers can change or remove free plans without notice. Confirm the current terms on the official site before you rely on a tool, upload anything private, or build a business process around it.
verification_note: Each entry records the date our editor last reviewed the public offer and official link. Verification is a point-in-time check, not a warranty or an endorsement. Limits use plain-language summaries; a provider's current pricing page and terms always win.
privacy_note: No account is worth your patient data, client records, unpublished manuscripts, passwords, financial details, or identity documents. Review each provider's privacy policy and your workplace rules before uploading anything sensitive.

access_legend.free-tier: A no-cost plan with caps, feature gates, queues, or usage credits. No card should be required for the free tier unless noted.
access_legend.free: Free to use at the core, though optional paid upgrades or platform purchases may exist.
access_legend.open-source: Source code is available and you can run it yourself. Free software is not the same as free hardware, electricity, storage, or model downloads.
access_legend.self-hosted: The software can be run on your own machine or server at no license cost, with source available under provider terms. You supply the hardware, maintenance, and model access.
